proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The report shows each reading against the ideal band, like a little gauge. After a month I actually understand my own pool. pH used to drift high and now it sits at 7.5.
reviews.name: Allison K.

reviews.text: Another company sold me a new salt cell twice in three years. Priya tested the output, cleaned the old one and it reads fine. Saved me a bill I did not need.
reviews.name: Derrick F.

reviews.text: I manage four rental homes in Ocoee and Winter Garden. They time the visits around check-ins and send a dated photo of each pool. Guest complaints about the water stopped.
reviews.name: Laura B.

reviews.text: Used the gallons calculator on the site, then the tech checked it against his own math. We were off by a few hundred gallons. Nice to see the same numbers both ways.
reviews.name: Ben H.

reviews.text: Pump made a scream at startup. They wrote down bearings, the part cost and labor, and said replacing the whole pump was not needed yet. Quiet since.
reviews.name: Teresa V.

reviews.text: Heat pump was blowing cold. They found a clogged coil and a bad sensor, fixed both in one visit and the water hit 84 that weekend.
reviews.name: Mark D.

reviews.text: Pressure gauge was at 30 every week. They switched our filter cleaning to a schedule based on the reading and it stays near 18 now.
reviews.name: Yolanda P.

proof.guarantee: Every visit report lists all seven readings. If one is missing, that visit is free.
